resultJson.title: Add EndpointsSpec tests for API endpoints
resultJson.body:
Adds `EndpointsSpec`, which tests `Endpoints.apiEndpoints` through Tapir's stub interpreter with an sttp stub backend, so no server is started.

Covered: `hello` and `int` (success and 400 on bad or missing input), `books/list/all` (response decoded and compared to `Library.books`), and `graphviz` for the SVG, PNG and DOT output formats.

The diff also includes `.orca/settings.properties` and an orca run progress file, which are tooling files and not part of the tests.
